notes.title: From Eden to Genesis: The Evolution Starts Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176828/a33daee5ea9175a3e03344f176f4fc0880e6ce9d.png[/img]
[h1]We’re back stronger than ever, Survivors![/h1]
After major internal improvements and key development changes, we’re excited to announce that [b]Eden Survivors[/b] is evolving and now becomes [b]GENESIS SURVIVORS[/b].

This new name marks the beginning of a new era for the game—[u]more ambitious, intense, and brutal[/u].
[h2]What are we working on?[/h2][list]  [*]New and challenging [b]biomes[/b].[/*]  [*]Relentless [b]enemies[/b] with unique mechanics.[/*]  [*][b]Epic bosses[/b] that will push your skills to the limit.[/*][/list]
We want every run to feel unique, every battle unforgettable, and every survival a real achievement.
[h2]What's coming in 2025[/h2]
We’ll soon start sharing [b]new concept art and designs[/b] to whet your appetite. And believe us—[b]this is just the beginning[/b].
[h2]Thank you for being part of this journey[/h2]
Your [b]feedback[/b] and support have been essential in helping us grow. You're helping shape a stronger, deeper, and more exciting experience.
[h2]Follow us on Steam[/h2]
Don’t miss any updates:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3073350]Latest news on Steam[/url]

[b]The origin has begun.[/b]

notes.title: Eden Survivors: Coming to PlayStation & Nintendo Switch + Sneak Peek at New Boss
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176828/34e741a5874dfa33eca0205d2a11ead9ea0df718.jpg[/img]
Hello, Survivors!

First of all, the entire Eden Survivors team wants to deeply thank you for your continuous support and incredible patience during these past months. We know you're eagerly awaiting news about the game, and we're excited to finally share some important updates!

Over the last few months, our main priority has been working hard to bring Eden Survivors to PlayStation and Nintendo Switch. This process required a great deal of dedication and effort from the studio, as each platform has unique requirements. We're thrilled to announce that Eden Survivors will soon be available on both platforms. Currently, some regions are still awaiting final approval, but rest assured, the game will be accessible in all regions by the end of this month!

We understand waiting can be challenging, but we're confident that expanding to these new platforms will greatly enrich the experience and bring more players into the adventure we've created together.

But wait—there's more exciting news! To reward your patience and constant support, we're giving you an early look at something special: a brand new, thrilling boss! This will be a formidable challenge that we're certain you'll enjoy conquering.

We also want to emphasize how much we value your feedback. Your opinions, suggestions, and comments are crucial to us and greatly help us improve Eden Survivors every day. Don't forget that you can continue sharing your feedback and participating in our community directly through our official Discord channel. We absolutely love hearing from you and addressing your concerns!

Finally, we'd like to ask you for a small favor. We understand delays can be frustrating, but we would greatly appreciate it if your patience and understanding could also be reflected in your in-game reviews. We acknowledge that developing a game—particularly as an indie studio—is a complex and evolving process. We're tirelessly working to deliver the best possible experience, and it’s sometimes unfair to receive negative reviews due to waiting times caused by our commitment to enhancing Eden Survivors.

Every update, improvement, and new feature we introduce is made possible because of your ongoing support. Let's continue building this incredible adventure together!

Don't forget to join our official Discord, where you can directly share your thoughts with the team and our community.

Thank you so much, Survivors! See you very soon on PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and, of course, in Eden Survivors!

#EdenSurvivors #Update #NewFinalBoss #AeternumGameStudios

notes.title: Eden Survivors: Now in Early Access! Play, Explore, and Share Your Feedback
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176828/c12f4e5dc2a575d4f32c6510f5cb1f338ac07f11.jpg[/img]
[h2]Eden Survivors is now available in Early Access![/h2]
The wait is over! 🌟 We’re thrilled to announce that Eden Survivors is now available on Early Access on Steam. This is just the beginning of an adventure we’ll build together, and we want YOU to be a part of it!

🎮 What’s included in this Early Access version?

This first version is packed with content ready for you to explore:

[list]
[*] 1 complete biome, full of secrets to uncover and challenges to conquer.
[*] All abilities and a progression tree, giving you the freedom to experiment and adapt your playstyle.
[*] 4 unique mechs, each with its own gameplay style for you to master.
[*] All final bosses of the first biome, bringing epic challenges we can’t wait for you to tackle!
[*] 20 to 100 hours of gameplay, depending on how deeply you dive into this epic experience.
[/list]
🗨️ Your feedback is key
This is just the beginning. We want to hear your thoughts and learn how we can improve. Share your feedback on our forums, social media, or Discord. Your input will be essential to shaping Eden Survivors into its best version!

📣 Join the conversation: Forums, Discord, Social Media, 

🚀 Play, explore, and be part of Eden Survivors’ evolution

[h3]Thank you for joining us on this journey. See you on the battlefield![/h3]
